$comment: Upstream Storybook stories the showcase deliberately does not port, with the reason. parity.js reports any other upstream story without an Elm twin as missing.
komponenter-button--colors-hover: Storybook's pseudo-state plugin simulating :hover on the Colors story; nothing to port.
komponenter-button--colors-pressed: Storybook's pseudo-state plugin simulating :active on the Colors story; nothing to port.
komponenter-search--deprecated-markup: Hand-written deprecated markup; deprecated upstream APIs are not ported.
komponenter-suggestion--with-deprecated-: Hand-written deprecated markup; deprecated upstream APIs are not ported.
komponenter-suggestion--custom-matching: Needs onBeforeMatch, which is not ported for the experimental Suggestion.
